<p>In 1920s New York, a plucky young animator named Elias Friedman dreams of becoming a world-famous cartoonist... and soon, his creation Rascal Randy makes that dream a reality. But as the fluffy rabbit takes the country by storm, a sinister underbelly reveals itself — and its impact will reverberate throughout history, all the way to present-day Aurora Springs.</p>
